Card Q&A.a: No. Even if multiple Digimon are deleted simultaneously, you can't draw more than 1 card per turn with this card's inherited effect.
Card Q&A.q: This Digimon's [On Play] effect deletes 4 of my opponent's Digimon. Does this Digimon’s [Your Turn] effect cause me to draw 4 cards?

Effect: [On Play] Delete 4 of your opponent's unsuspended level 4 or lower Digimon.
[Your Turn][Once Per Turn] When one of your opponent's Digimon is deleted, ＜Draw 1＞. (Draw 1 card from your deck.)
